# GenAI Engineer — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Typed client with retries

*Module 1: LLM fundamentals for builders · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_tokens_context_and_tools.py`): Measure your own system prompt and tool list. What share of every request is overhead before the user has typed a word?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Parse a messy two-column PDF

*Module 2: Ingestion (L0-L3) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_ingestion_messy_documents.py`): Export one of your own PDFs to text. Find three kinds of damage (columns, headers/footers, hyphenation). Fix one in code and re-test retrieval.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Contextual prefix; inspect chunks

*Module 3: Chunking and enrichment (L4-L5) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_chunking_strategies.py`): Print ten of your own chunks. For each: would it make sense to a stranger? Then measure recall before and after adding the prefix.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Hybrid + rerank; recall@20

*Module 4: Embedding, storage, hybrid retrieval, reranking (L6-L12) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_hybrid_retrieval_recall.py`): Build a 20-query labelled set for your corpus (query → relevant chunk ids). Report recall@20 for retrieval and nDCG@5 after reranking. Which stage is your bottleneck?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Multi-turn grounded bot

*Module 5: Query understanding and generation (L9, L13-L15) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_query_and_grounded_generation.py`): Run a five-turn conversation against your own bot. Log the rewritten query each turn. Where did the rewrite lose or invent something?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 6 — 50-query golden set in CI

*Module 6: Evaluation (L17) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 6** (`python demos/06_golden_set_ci_gate.py`): Write 10 golden queries for your system with expected facts and type. Wire `evals.gate` into your CI so a drop of more than 3 points fails the build.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 7 — Router: simple / RAG / agent

*Module 7: Agents and routing (L22-L27) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 7** (`python demos/07_router_simple_rag_agent.py`): Classify 20 real questions from your logs into simple / RAG / agent by hand. What share truly needs an agent? Build the router for the majority first.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 8 — Trace + cost dashboard; capstone

*Module 8: Production (L18-L21) · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 8** (`python demos/08_production_trace_and_cost.py`): Add a trace to your own app with these seven spans. Which span is slowest? Which is most expensive? Which has no alert?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
